articles.summary: WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - LXP Industrial Trust (NYSE: LXP) (“LXP” or “the Company”) today announced that its shareholders approved the acquisition of LXP by Brookfield Asset Management (NYSE: BAM, TSX: BAM) and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board at the Special Meeting of Shareholders held earlier today. According to the results of the Special Meeting of Shareholders, more than 99% of votes cast at the meeting – which represented approximately 82% of the outstanding LXP common shares as of the record date – were voted in favor of approving the merger. The final voting results of the Special Meeting of Shareholders will be filed as part of LXP’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) after certification by LXP’s inspector of election.
